subject: Post-call: ownership map, procurement onramp & next steps

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medcore.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, procurement@medcore.io, Lars Svensson <l.svensson@medcore.io>
Date: 2026-08-01T15:14:00Z
Subject: Post-call: ownership map, procurement onramp & next steps

Thanks again for the time today, Oliver — good conversation and clear next steps on both the pilot scope and procurement path. Quick written recap so we have a single place to track asks: 

1) Org / sign-off roster: can you confirm the decision-makers and the economic buyer? you mentioned Sarah Lim as the exec sponsor — can you add her title and email if convenient.
2) Procurement timeline: rough dates for PO / SOW signoff and any internal review windows (security, legal).
3) Security contacts: who owns SOC2 evidence & data residency signoff (name + email).
4) Decision criteria alignment: what success metrics will your stakeholders use to evaluate a pilot? performance / latency vs cost / data handling?

We attached a quick post-call notes pdf (postcall-notes.pdf) with the pilot assumptions we took down. If you can share a simple org chart or a short list (name / role / approval lane) that would be ideal — we’ll prepare a procurement-ready brief and the SOC2 excerpt to speed things up.

Next steps (proposed):
- Oliver: share org chart + procurement timeline (by Fri, Aug 6)
- Redwood (Monica/Aditya): compile a 1-page procurement brief + SOC2 excerpt and a short decision-criteria mapping (ETA Tue, Aug 3)
- Quick follow (15 min) next week to confirm signoff path once we have the roster.

Thanks — I’ll loop back to your procurement lead once we have the org list.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Diego.Fernandez@redwood.ai
Attachment: postcall-notes.pdf (summary of pilot scope and assumptions)

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medcore.io>

Subject: Re: Post-call: ownership map, procurement onramp & next steps

Diego — thanks, helpful recap. Attaching the org chart you requested (MedCore_OrgChart_v2.pdf). Quick answers inline: 

- Economic buyer / exec sponsor: Sarah Lim, VP Product (sarah.lim@medcore.io). She’ll own the final signoff.
- Procurement / commercial: procurement@medcore.io (primary), procurement lead: Rajesh Patel (rajesh.patel@medcore.io). Expect a standard 2–3 week internal procurement window once SOW is in place.
- Security / compliance: Lars Svensson (legal/security contact, l.svensson@medcore.io) will run the SOC2/PII review.
- Decision criteria: top priorities are privacy & data separation, predictable latency under 300ms, and cost predictability for bursty traffic.

I’ve attached the OrgChart and embedded a short note on the procurement cadence. If you can send the procurement brief and the SOC2 excerpt, I’ll route those to Rajesh and Lars for an initial read.

Oliver
Oliver Grant
Director of Data & AI | MedCore Health
oliver.grant@medcore.io

Can you both have initial drafts by EOD Monday (Aug 2)? I’ll send the draft to Oliver and cc Rajesh / Lars for early feedback.

Thanks — forwarding original message for context.
